display_long_description:
Roachdown is a casual VR shooter set in a grimy abandoned kitchen at night, where the roaches have taken over and you're the last line of defense.
Grab two pistols, blast anything that crawls or flies, and shake your gun in the air to reload,  no clip management, no menus, no fumbling. Just point, squeeze, and shake when empty.
You start slow. A few harmless roaches wander across the floor while you get your bearings. Then the attackers come — scuttling toward you, leaping up, taking flight, hovering around your head, and lunging at your face. The longer you survive, the more come, and their movements shift from predictable patterns into full chaos. Get bitten too many times and it's game over. Shoot the REPLAY button to dive back in.
No campaigns. No menus to fight through. No boring tutorials. Just immediate arcade action with a satisfying click-and-splatter loop you can pick up for five minutes between meetings, or chase a high score for an hour.
Features:
• Casual gameplay, no aim-training required
• Endless waves with gradually ramping difficulty
• Dual-wield pistol combat
• Shake-to-reload mechanic
• Atmospheric horror soundscape and gore VFX
• Quick play sessions, endless replayability
Built for Meta Quest 2 and 3.
How long can you hold them off?
